title: Query-contract integrity gate marks an ACTIVE CPF query as orphan
actual: FAIL: Orphan SQL resource is not explicitly STAGED: module=cpf key=channel-policy-find-all
contract: channel-policy-find-all is declared ACTIVE for JdbcCpfChannelRegistryAdapter and has a rendered canonical resource.
rootCause: The cpf contract scans only cpf-core/src/main/java although every declared live consumer is in current Starter/Admin owners. Both query gates therefore see zero keys. In addition, the integrity gate tries to emit collected failures with Write-Error while ErrorActionPreference=Stop, so it aborts on the first issue instead of reporting the full fail-closed inventory.
provenCurrentConsumer: JdbcCpfChannelRegistryAdapter line 63 calls sql.required("channel-policy-find-all"); the first failure is verifier scope drift, not an orphan Product query.
next: Currentize exact live source scopes and all-error reporting, fix the invalid/missing Product consumers, then rerun both complete query gates.
falseGreenForbidden: Do not mark ACTIVE as STAGED, add an allowlist, hide the resource, or bypass orphan detection.
